captions.detailed: This 3D model is a robust, octagonal casing designed as the base module for a multi-path colorimeter. The exterior features an eight-sided polygonal shape with rounded vertical edges and a flat bottom. Inside, there is a central cylindrical cavity designed to hold a cuvette, surrounded by radial compartments and vertical slide-in slots to secure sensor and LED boards. Small mounting holes are positioned along the outer corners of the top rim to attach a lid.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, multi-path colorimeter case in OpenSCAD. The script should allow the user to adjust the number of signal paths (which determines the polygonal shape of the case, e.g., 4 paths for an octagon), the cuvette diameter, and the sensor/LED board dimensions, complete with internal board-retaining slots and a central cuvette holder cavity.
captions.factory: The code generates an octagonal case by subtracting internal features from a solid exterior shape. The exterior is constructed using a hull of rotated cylinders placed at the vertices. The internal chambers (cavities) are modeled as rounded trapezoids using hulls of cylinders, which are then subtracted radially using a for-loop. A central cylinder is subtracted to form the cuvette holder space, and additional cylinders are subtracted at the corners to create vertical mounting screw holes.
